notes: breast cancer: 'breast cancer' resolved to MeSH 'Breast Neoplasms' (source: sample; verified: covers 83% of trials found by the words, 14,571 trials in the registry, including subtypes).
lung cancer: 'lung cancer' resolved to MeSH 'Lung Neoplasms' (source: sample; verified: covers 80% of trials found by the words, 11,790 trials in the registry, including subtypes).
breast cancer: only the first 5000 of 16211 matching trials were analyzed (max_studies=5000).
lung cancer: only the first 5000 of 12784 matching trials were analyzed (max_studies=5000).
365 trials appear in both 'breast cancer' and 'lung cancer' and are counted in each.
percent is the share of each series' trials, so series of different sizes can be compared.
NCT ID lists are capped per datum; trial_count is always the full count.

source_count / source_percent are exact counts from ClinicalTrials.gov for each category, using the same query as the records; trial_count / percent come from the analyzed sample, which was truncated.
